state.hypothesis: Ambient particulate matter exposure increases pulmonary inflammation in individuals with pre-existing respiratory disease.

sentences.0: We measured fractional exhaled nitric oxide (FENO), spirometry, blood pressure, oxygen saturation of the blood (SaO2), and pulse rate in 16 older subjects with asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in Seattle, Washington.
sentences.1: Data were collected daily for 12 days.
sentences.10: Interest in particulate matter (PM) air pollution has been driven by epidemiologic studies reporting adverse cardiac and respiratory health effects.
sentences.100: The indoor and outdoor PM concentrations were measured with single-stage inertial HIs and 37-mm Teflon filters for PM10 and PM2.5.
sentences.101: One HI2.5–HI10 pair was located inside each home in the main activity room and connected to a pump (SP 280, Air Diagnostics Inc.).
sentences.102: Another HI2.5–HI10 pair was located outside each home and connected to a pump (SP 280).
sentences.103: The on and off flow rates were calibrated and recorded daily with a rotameter (150-nm Tube 604; Cole-Parmer Instrument Co., Vernon Hills, IL).
sentences.104: All HI sampling periods were for 24 hr (approximately 1100 hr to 1100 hr) at a flow rate of 10 L/min.
sentences.105: Our research group has previously evaluated the performance of continuous PM monitors (nephelometers) and HIs used in the context of a panel study.
sentences.106: Simultaneous data also were collected with a MPEM10 during the study period (24 hr for 12 consecutive session days).
sentences.107: The MPEM10 was connected to a personal pump (400S: BGI, Inc., Waltham, MA) with a mass flow controller operated at 4 L/min.
sentences.108: Each subject carried an MPEM10 in the breathing zone for 24 hr, except while sleeping or showering.
sentences.109: The monitor was attached to the shoulder strap of either a backpack or a fanny pack that contained the air pump.
sentences.11: To further investigate the basis for these epidemiologic findings, it is important to assess individual exposures to PM and their related health effects.
sentences.110: When the monitor was not worn, it was placed at an elevation of 3–5 ft (e.g., on a table) close to the subjects.
sentences.111: Field technicians visited the subjects daily to calibrate the pumps with a rotameter and to record on and off flow rates and change samplers.
sentences.112: We weighed the filters before and after sample collection for particle mass concentration.
sentences.113: All filter weights were measured in either duplicate or triplicate using an electronic ultra-microbalance (UMT2: Mettler Toledo, Greifensee, Switzerland).
sentences.114: The filters were equilibrated for at least 24 hr before weighing.
sentences.115: We performed both equilibration and weighing inside a controlled environmental chamber with constant relative humidity (34.7°C ± 2.5%) and temperature (22.4 °C ± 1.9%).
sentences.116: Standard protocols included the use of field blanks, filter-lot blanks, laboratory blanks, and externally certified standard weights for all gravimetric analyses for quality assurance and quality control purposes.
sentences.117: Relative humidity, outdoor temperature, NO, and NO2 concentrations were monitored continuously at the Beacon Hill central site by the Washington State Department of Ecology.
sentences.118: Black carbon measurements.
sentences.119: We estimated BC, a measure shown to represent EC from motor vehicles and woodstoves in Seattle, using an integrated plate reader.
sentences.12: Panel studies that include indoor, outdoor, personal, and fixed-site PM monitoring can provide an important link between the effects observed in a population and the effects at the individual subject level.
sentences.120: It is generally agreed that the major contributor to light absorption by airborne particles is BC, and levels of BC can easily be measured by this nondestructive optical technique.
sentences.121: The method derives absorption from the change in light transmission through a Teflon filter on which particles have been collected.
sentences.122: We analyzed the filters from the HIs for BC (wavelength of 525 nm) after the mass measurements.
sentences.123: The integrated plate reader was re-zeroed with a blank filter between measurements.
sentences.124: The light absorption coefficient, bap, was computed using the amount of light transmitted through this exposed filter, the amount transmitted through the same filter before sampling, and the volume of air that passed through the filter.
sentences.125: We used a previously derived association between bap and EC in Seattle to quantify the BC concentrations.
sentences.126: Statistical analysis.
sentences.127: We hypothesized that increases in PM2.5 and BC are associated with increases in FENO.
sentences.128: We analyzed within-subject, within-session associations between FENO and air pollution metrics using a linear mixed effects model with random intercept, controlling for age, relative humidity, and temperature.
sentences.129: Subjects were stratified by health status in the FENO, spirometry, and SaO2 analyses.
sentences.13: Panel studies often report gravimetric measures of PM.
sentences.130: We put use of cardiac medications into the model as an interaction term for the blood pressure and pulse rate analyses.
sentences.131: The model included terms for within-subject, within-session (12-day monitoring period) effects; within-subject, between-session effects; the confounding variable of temperature; and relative humidity.
sentences.132: Our primary interest was the within-subject, within-session effects of PM2.5 and BC on FENO levels.
sentences.133: Our numerous exploratory analyses, the within-subject, within-session effects of PM2.5, PM10, and BC on spirometry, SaO2, blood pressure, and pulse rate required use of the Bonferroni test for multiple comparisons.
sentences.134: The Bonferroni test indicated a value of p < 0.0001 was significant.
sentences.135: Therefore, for these analyses we chose p < 0.0001 as our criteria for statistical significance.
sentences.136: We used STATA software (Stata Corp., College Station, TX).

sentences.139: Results
sentences.14: However, current research is focusing on the constituents of PM.
sentences.140: Subject characteristics.
sentences.141: Characteristics of the 16 subjects are given in Table 1.
sentences.142: On average, the subjects spent 88% of their time indoors at home, 3% of their time in transit, and 9% of their time indoors away from home.
sentences.143: Four subjects reported having received both a doctor’s diagnosis of asthma and of COPD.
sentences.144: Airborne concentration measurements.
sentences.145: The measured concentrations and interquartile ranges of PM10, PM2.5, and BC are presented in Table 2 for all the subjects, for the 7 subjects with asthma alone, and for the 9 subjects with COPD.
sentences.146: At the fixed-site monitor, the overall 24-hr average PM2.5 was 14.0 μg/m3, the 24-hr minimum was 1.3 μg/m3, and the 24-hr maximum was 44 μg/m3.
sentences.147: At the same site the overall 24-hr average PM10 was 18.0 μg/m3, the 24-hr minimum was 2.5 μg/m3, and the 24-hr maximum was 51 μg/m3.
sentences.148: The overall 24-hr average BC was 7.2 μg/m3, the 24-hr minimum was below detection limits, and the 24-hr maximum was 2.6 μg/m3.
sentences.149: Exhaled NO.
sentences.15: Elemental carbon (EC) is one component of PM that has been associated with respiratory health effects in children.
sentences.150: A total of 179 midday breath samples were collected during the 12-day monitoring periods.
sentences.151: Average FENO levels are shown in Table 3.
sentences.152: The mean FENO levels were higher for those with COPD (25.4 ppb) than for those with asthma (19.2 ppb) or COPD and asthma (16.5 ppb).
sentences.153: In those subjects with asthma, a 10 μg/m3 increase in outdoor PM2.5 and PM10, relative to each subject session average, was associated with a 4.2 ppb [95% confidence interval (CI), 1.3–7.1; p = 0.004) and 5.9 ppb (95% CI, 2.9–8.9; p = 0.000) increase in FENO, respectively.
sentences.154: There was no association between FENO and the 24-hr measures of indoor PM2.5 or PM10.
sentences.155: A 1 μg/m3 increase in outdoor, indoor, and personal BC, relative to each subject session average, was associated with a 2.3 ppb increase in FENO (95% CI, 1.08–3.57; p = 0.000), a 4.0 ppb increase in FENO (95% CI, 2.02–5.91; p = 0.000), and a 1.2 ppb increase in FENO (95% CI, 0.17–2.22; p = 0.02), respectively (Table 3).
sentences.156: No significant association was found between PM or BC and changes in FENO in subjects with COPD.
sentences.157: The effect levels and confidence intervals are given in Table 3.
sentences.158: SaO2, blood pressure, and pulse rate.
sentences.159: No associations were observed between air pollution and SaO2, blood pressure, or pulse rate in this study.
sentences.16: In a 10-year study of 1,759 children, found a strong association between reduced annual growth in forced expiratory volume in 1 sec (FEV1) in children and exposure to EC, nitrogen dioxide, and acid vapor.
sentences.160: Discussion
sentences.161: This study showed an association between FENO in elderly subjects with asthma and indoor and outdoor BC.
sentences.162: Increases in FENO also were associated with outdoor PM10 and PM2.5 in these same subjects.
sentences.163: Results of this study are consistent with our earlier study of children with asthma who were not on corti-costeroid therapy.
sentences.164: That study showed an increase of approximately 4 ppb FENO associated with a 10 μg/m3 increases in indoor, outdoor, personal, and central-site PM2.5 in Seattle.
sentences.165: Finding a similar magnitude of response in the two different groups (children and elderly with asthma) strengthens the importance of this finding.
sentences.166: Results of the present study also are consistent with other earlier studies in Seattle showing that hospitalizations for asthma as well as increases in asthma symptoms and increased use of rescue medications are associated with fine particles in Seattle.
sentences.167: Our data suggest that exposure to PM10 may play an important role in asthma exacerbation.
sentences.168: This significant association between FENO and PM10 was not surprising, especially for subjects with asthma that have narrowed airways, as the thoracic coarse particles deposit preferentially in the larger bronchial airways and these airways may be the ones with the greatest inflammation potential.
sentences.169: The observed association is supported by studies that have linked PM10 to pulmonary inflammation in animal models and the induction of inducible nitric oxide synthase in human bronchial epithelial cells.
sentences.17: EC, measured on quartz filters by thermal desorption, is strongly associated with, but not identical to, “black carbon” (BC), as measured by diffuse transmittance through or reflectance from a Teflon filter.
sentences.170: Other studies have also reported positive associations between FENO and ambient exposures to air pollutants in community-based studies.
sentences.171: reported that an increase in the 24-hr average PM2.5 concentration of 17.7 μg/m3 was associated with a 1.45 ppb increase in FENO in elderly subjects with asthma and COPD in a panel study in Steubenville, Ohio. reported a 1-day and 2-day lag association between FENO and PM10, black smoke, and NO.
sentences.172: In contrast, no increase in FENO was seen in adult subjects with asthma after exposure to concentrated coarse particles or ultrafine particles.
sentences.173: Several controlled ozone exposure studies have assessed FENO in atopic subjects with asthma and healthy subjects, but none has found an association.
sentences.174: We found that FENO was associated with PM air pollution in study participants with asthma but not those with COPD.
sentences.175: It is interesting that five of the seven subjects with asthma were using inhaled corticosteroids, which has been associated with mitigation of eNO in air pollution studies and clinical settings.
sentences.176: This finding contrasts with that of a study of elderly subjects by that found a PM2.5 response in subjects with COPD but not asthma, although there was some overlap in the study population and medications were not recorded.
sentences.177: In our study, levels of FENO, on average, were higher in COPD than asthma subjects.
sentences.178: Exhaled NO in stable COPD has been found to be lower than in nonsmoking asthmatics, but patients with unstable COPD have higher NO levels than ex-smokers with COPD.
sentences.179: BC may more closely identify the sources of PM than standard measures of mass concentration.
sentences.18: In a recent study, reported that concentrations of traffic-related pollutants (PM, BC, total nitrogen oxides, and NO2) were associated with respiratory symptoms in children.
sentences.180: The contribution of BC to total PM varies geographically and temporally due to the distribution of the combustion sources that produce BC.
sentences.181: Although BC is a major component of diesel exhaust, it is also a major component of particles produced by burning vegetation.
sentences.182: Recent source apportionment studies in Seattle found that burning vegetation and mobile sources are major contributors to PM2.5 and that burning vegetation is the dominant contributor to variations in the day-to-day BC in the winter.
sentences.183: Burning vegetation, and to a lesser extent, mobile sources, may therefore be responsible for the observed increases in FENO associated with BC.
sentences.184: It is somewhat surprising that we did not find an association between standard spirometry measures and association with PM2.5, PM10, and BC.
sentences.185: An earlier study completed in Seattle during the wood-burning season showed that spirometry, specifically FVC and FEV1, decreased in association with increases in particulate matter air pollution in children with asthma.
sentences.186: Another study, in Vancouver, British Columbia Canada, showed a slight but not statistically significant decrease in daily FEV1 change in subjects with COPD was associated with increase in PM2.5.
sentences.187: In three separate longitudinal diary studies, decreases in PEF were shown to be associated with increased levels of PM2.5.
sentences.188: Our exploratory hypotheses were that increases in PM2.5 and BC are associated with decreases in spirometry (FEV1, MEF) and SaO2 and with increases in blood pressure and pulse rate.
sentences.189: In our study, no significant associations were seen between these health measures and PM2.5, PM10, or BC (indoor, outdoor, personal).
sentences.19: EC and BC have also been associated with cardiovascular health effects.
sentences.190: Some studies have found that PM10 and PM2.5 both appear to affect lung function in asthmatics; however, many of the studies experienced higher mean PM concentrations (in the range of 50 μg/m3) than were experienced by subjects in this study.
sentences.191: The lack of significant associations between SaO2 and PM has also been observed in other studies.
sentences.192: In addition, no significant associations were observed between blood pressure and pulse rate and PM2.5, PM10, and BC in this study.
sentences.193: This is in contrast to studies that have reported increases in blood pressure and pulse rate with exposure to PM.
sentences.194: Our study results are consistent with those of a larger panel study in Seattle, but that study did see minor decreases in pulse rate in healthy subjects.
sentences.195: Yet another study did find some changes in ectopic beats in subjects with COPD.
sentences.196: To our knowledge the present study is the first air pollution study simultaneously exploring FENO, spirometry, and cardiac outcomes.
sentences.197: It appears that FENO is more sensitive to changes in PM2.5, PM10, and BC than the other outcomes.
sentences.198: This finding emphasizes the importance of including noninvasive, sensitive measures of health outcomes in panel studies.
sentences.199: The intensive monitoring of health effects and PM metrics in this study of susceptible individuals provides better estimates of actual exposures than epidemiologic data based on PM2.5 at a central site.

sentences.1: No cytogenetic effects in lymphocytes of stainless steel welders.
sentences.10: Certain nickel compounds have mutagenic properties in mammalian test systems in vitro (11,24,25,33,34,35).
sentences.11: An increased frequency of chromosome aberrations in peripheral lymphocytes has been reported for workers engaged in chromium production (3).
sentences.12: Certain chromium (VI) and nickel compounds are carcinogenic in animals and man (11,12,18,24,26,33,35).
sentences.13: Chromium (VI) and nickel are present in stainless steel welding fumes (20,32,36).
sentences.14: Such fumes, especially from manual metal arc welding, have been shown to be mutagenic in vitro in bacteria and mammalian cells (8,15,21), as well as positive in the mammalian spot test (14).
sentences.15: Chromium has been suspected to be a causative agent (8,15).
sentences.16: The mutagenic effect seems to be diminished or eliminated in the case of welding fumes (8), as well as in the case of chromium (7,19,28) in the presence of rat liver microsome fraction or human erythrocyte lysate (28).
sentences.17: Microsomal preparation from rat lung was however a poor inactivator of chromium mutagenicity (28).
sentences.18: Recently a retrospective cohort study of mortality suggested an association between lung cancer and stainless steel welding (31).
sentences.19: In addition a slight excess of lung cancer deaths was noted among welders with mixed exposure (29).

sentences.20: Similarly a proportionate mortality study reported that welders and flamecutters had an excess of lung and urinary bladder cancer (22).

sentences.35: The average number used then was 98 (range 35-196).
sentences.36: The diameter of the electrodes was between 3.25 and 5.0 mm, in a few cases 2.5 mm.
sentences.37: The corresponding current used was 100 to 250 A, in a few cases 80 A.
sentences.38: Some of the welders under study used welding shields, and others used respiratory protective devices when working in narrow spaces, while others used no such equipment.
sentences.39: All industries had general ventilation; some also had local exhaust systems.
sentences.4: No cytogenetic effects in lymphocytes of stainless steel welders.

sentences.42: Both subjects in one pair used a betablocker as antihypertensive treatment.

sentences.6: As a first step in testing this hypothesis it was necessary to show that ortho hydroxy-amines are in fact carcinogenic.
sentences.60: l-Amino-2-naphthol hydrochloride (10/36-27.8 per cent) is a potent carcinogen under the conditions of bladder implantation.

sentences.62: 1-Phenylazo-2-naphthol (8/32-25 per cent) is also carcinogenic to the bladder epithelium when locally applied.
sentences.63: The results obtained with pellets containing 4-aminodiphenyl and its derivatives (Table V) are very similar to those obtained with the analogous naphthalene compounds.
sentences.64: Although the tumour yield with 4-aminodiphenyl (3/35-8'6 per cent) was not significantly different from that with paraffin wax alone the tumours were much better established.
sentences.65: 3-Hydroxy-4-aminodiphenyl sulphate (9/38-23.7 per cent) is a potent carcinogen whereas when the oxygen atom is substituted in 4-amino-3-diphenylyl sodium sulphate (1/21-4.8 per cent) the carcinogenic activity is suppressed.
sentences.66: A preliminary group of twenty mice implanted with pellets containing 4'-nitro-4-amino-3-hydroxydiphenyl hydrochloride (X) yielded three well established and invasive carcinomas (15 per cent).
sentences.67: Thus, this compound is apparently carcinogenic.
sentences.68: DISCUSSION.
sentences.69: The present experiments confirm the value of the technique of the implantation of paraffin wax pellets containing suspected substances into the lumen of the bladder of the mouse as a test for carcinogenic activity.
sentences.7: It has recently been shown that 4-aminodiphenyl (para-xenylamine, VII)    carcinogen (Melick, Escue, Naryka, Mezera and Wheeler, 1955): it rapidly induces tumours in the dog (Walpole, Williams and Roberts, 1954: Deichmann,  Coplan, Woods, Anderson, Heslin and Radomski, 1956): and it is relatively slow acting in the rat (Walpole, Williams and Roberts, 1952).
sentences.70: The chemicals tested fall into three groups; (i) the four ortho hydroxy-amines, 2-amino-1-naphthol hydro- chloride (II), 1-amino-2-naphthol hydrochloride (VI), 3-hydroxy-4-aminodiphenyl sulphate (VIII) and probably 4'-nitro-3-hydroxy-4-aminodiphenyl hydrochloride (X) and also the food colorant 1-phenylazo-2-naphthol (V) are carcinogenic; (ii) 2-amino-1-naphthyl hydrogen sulphate (III), 2-dimethylamino-1-methoxynaph- thalene hydrochloride (IV), and 4-amino-3-diphenylyl sodium sulphate (IX) are inactive, while (iii) 2-naphthylamine (I) and possibly 4-aminodiphenyl (VII) occupy an intermediate position.
sentences.71: The occurrence of tumours with paraffin wax alone may be due to the presence of a foreign body in the mouse bladder or to a low degree of carcinogenic activity in the wax used.
sentences.72: The latter seems possible as Pullinger (personal communication)   has implanted pellets of another batch of wax with and without added material into the bladders of mice and has only obtained one papilloma in 37 mice surviving 25-106 weeks.
sentences.73: As in the present experiments the incidence of tumours with the paraffin wax was 3.5 per cent, and with the ortho hydroxyamines was only 15-30 per cent, groups of not less than thirty mice were necessary to give a significant yield of tumours.
sentences.74: Groups of 200-250 mice would be necessary to establish the significance of the results with 2-naphthylamine and 4-aminodiphenyl, with which the tumour incidence was only about 8 per cent.
sentences.75: The tumours obtained with 2-naphthylamine are not likely to be due to an impurity in the chemical as the incidence of tumours on implantation with 2-naph- thylamine purified by distillation and recrystallisation (Bonser, 1943) and by gradient sublimation (Henson et al., 1954) are similar.
sentences.76: Bonser, Clayson, Jull, and  Pyrah (1956) showed that when 2-naphthylamine was allowed to stand in oily solution it slowly developed the ability to induce sarcomas when injected sub- cutaneously into mice.
sentences.77: It is probable that a similar mechanism would account for the 2-naphthylamine tumours in the present experiments.
sentences.78: Demonstration of the carcinogenic activity of the ortho hydroxy-amines 2-amino-l-naphthol, 1-amino-2-naphthol and 3-hydroxy-4-aminodiphenyl under the conditions of bladder implantation strongly supports the hypothesis that aromatic amines induce cancer by virtue of their transformation in the body to ortho hydroxy-amines.
sentences.79: This activity may be due to (i) direct reaction of the ortho hydroxy-amines with the tissue constituents, (ii) conversion of the ortho-hydroxy- amines to the "true carcinogens " by the enzymes of the tissues, or (iii) conversion of the ortho hydroxy-amines to the "true carcinogens" chemically in the pellet or urine.
sentences.8: In the dog 4-amino- diphenyl is excreted into the urine as 4-amino-3-diphenylyl hydrogen sulphate (IX), (Bradshaw and Clayson, 1955), and Bradshaw (unpublished observation)  has shown that free 3-hydroxy-4-aminodiphenyl (VIII) is present in low concentra- tion in the urine of dogs receiving the chemical.
sentences.80: Even ifthe latter mechanismis operative it is likely that the tracesoffree ortho hydroxy-amines now known to be present in the urine of animals treated with the aromatic amines, will undergo similar conversions.
sentences.81: The explanation of the lack of activity of the tin complex of 2-amino-1-naphthol and the full activity of the similar complex of 1-amino-2-naphthol requires explanation.
sentences.82: It has been shown that 1-phenylazo-2-naphthol (V) as well as 1-amino-2- naphthol hydrochloride is carcinogenic to the mouse bladder.
sentences.83: It is possible that reduction of 1-phenylazo-2-naphthol takes place in the bladder epithelium.
sentences.84: Ross  and Warwick (1955) have shown that a series of azo compounds are reduced by the xanthine-oxidase-xanthine system and this and similar enxymes are present in many tissues.
sentences.85: The local biological activity of 1-phenylazo-2-naphthol has also been demonstrated by Green (personal communication) who has shown it to be a very active tumour inhibitor in rats, when applied by subcutaneous injection.
sentences.86: It was originally suggested that 2-amino-1-naphthyl hydrogen sulphate might be broken down in the bladder to the ortho hydroxy-amine (Bonser et al., 1952).
sentences.87: The lack of carcinogenic activity with the sulphate esters contraindicates this possibility, as does the observation of Boyland, Manson, Sims and Williams (1956) that some ortho aminophenyl hydrogen sulphates are not hydrolysed by known mammalian sulphatases.
sentences.88: They suggest that free ortho hydroxy-amines are produced in the urine by the enzymic hydrolysis of the corresponding ortho aminophenyl glucuronides or phosphates.
sentences.89: The results obtained by the bladder implantation method require confirmation by other methods.
sentences.9: Kirby and Peacock (1949)   found that the erstwhile food colorant 1-phenylazo-2-naphthol (Oil orange E) (V) induced-hepatomas in 7 of 24 mice surviving to a significant age and it was suggested (Clayson, 1953) that the activity of this compound might be due to its rcduction in the body to 1-amino-2-naphthol (VI).
sentences.90: Conventional techniques such as painting and feeding are not likely to be reliable because of the easy oxidation of these compounds, and because an optimum concentration is required at the site of tumour induction.
sentences.91: Subcu- taneous injection of 2-amino-l-naphthol hydrochloride (Bonser et al., 1952) produced a small yield of local sarcomas while Hueper (1938) obtained retro- thelial sarcomas in mice by intraperitoneal injection of the crude chemical.
sentences.92: Recently Miller and Miller (1955) attempted to induce tumours in rats by feeding 4-acetamidodiphenyl, 3-hydroxy-4-acetamidodiphenyl and 3-hydroxy-4-amino- diphenyl to rats.
sentences.93: They obtained a number of fibroadenomas of the breast during a period of twelve months, at which time they terminated the experiment.

sentences.97: The present results of testing ortho hydroxy-amines support the hypothesis that aromatic amines are carcinogenic by virtue of their conversion to ortho hydroxy-amines in the animal body.
sentences.98: It follows therefore that compounds which may give rise to ortho hydroxy-amines tn vivo should be regarded as potentially hazardous and that they should not be allowed to come into contact with human beinags either in the course of their work or as additives to foodstuffs. SUMMARY

sentences.148: Discussion
sentences.149: Quinone metabolites of benzene, particularly BQ, which damage both proteins and DNA, are among the most toxic metabolites of benzene (2).
sentences.15: Cytochrome P450 (CYP EC 1.14.14.1) is a family of enzymes that oxidize or reduce chemicals to reactive intermediates that may alkylate nucleic acids, proteins, and CYP itself (1).
sentences.150: We have reported that in vivo and in vitro CYP destruction caused by benzene and its metabolites was related to BQ and possibly to the SQ radical rather than to HQ or catechol (1).
sentences.151: However, autooxidation of various quinones is accompanied by the formation of reactive oxygen species (17).
sentences.152: Moreover, radicals induce lipid peroxidation and SQ is a product of redox cycling of HQ/BQ.
sentences.153: We have, therefore, investigated the role of reactive oxygen species and lipid peroxidation in the CYP destruction caused by quinone metabolites of benzene.

sentences.16: These metabolites (epoxides, radi- cals, aldehydes, and quinones) are believed to be responsible for mutagenicity and car- cinogenicity of chemicals, whereas their binding to CYP heme or protein inhibits or inactivates this enzyme.
sentences.160: Ascorbate was the most effective pro- tective agent against catechol, HQ, and BQ, indicating that their reduced forms were not toxic to CYP.
sentences.161: On the contrary, significantly increased CYP concentrations in catechol + ascorbate and hydroquinone + ascorbate-treated microsomes suggested a CYP activation that increased its binding of carbon monoxide.
sentences.162: A small, but significant protection of CYP against HQ and BQ by x-tocopherol indicated a possible role of SQ in their toxicity.
sentences.163: The data indicate that the quinones damage CYP via their oxidative forms, i.e., that HQ is rather toxic via its SQ or BQ product, while reac- tive oxygen species or lipid peroxidation might have additional, but less important, toxic effects.
sentences.164: HQ is known to autooxidize to SQ and BQ with simultaneous formation of a super- oxide anion (17) and hydrogen peroxide (16).
sentences.165: Iron, which is present in vivo as well as in phosphate buffers, catalyzes Haber-Weiss and Fenton reactions that form hydroxyl radicals.
sentences.166: However, OH radicals appeared to play a negligible role in HQ-or BQ- induced CYP destruction, since their forma- tion was not stimulated by HQ or BQ under conditions in which either quinone caused marked CYP destruction.
sentences.167: The addition of EDTA reduced both hydroxyl radicals and CYP destruction, suggesting a causal relationship.
sentences.168: Neverthe- less, the combined action of NADPH and HQ or BQ resulted in less CYP destruction when compared with their separate actions, whereas the formation of OH radicals was markedly higher.
sentences.169: Thus, the data suggest that the joint effect of NADPH and the quinones on CYP is not significantly mediated via OH' radicals.
sentences.17: Oxidative metabolites of benzene cause its myelotoxicity and carcinogenicity (2)  and CYP destruction (1,3).
sentences.170: Iron played an important role in the formation of OH-radicals induced by NADPH alone and acting together with HQ or BQ, as indicated by the decrease in hydroxyl radical formation caused by EDTA.
sentences.171: The mutual suppression of CYP damage caused by NADPH and the quinones during their joint action could be due to NADPH oxidation by HQ or BQ and by reduction of the quinones by NADPH.
sentences.172: Both HQ and BQ oxidized NADPH added to microsomes or in buffer, indicating a significant role of chemical NADPH oxidation.
sentences.173: At the same time, NADPH prevented spontaneous oxidation of HQ to BQ so that HQ levels were higher and BQ concentrations were lower than in microsomes without NADPH.
sentences.174: In the same way, BQ was reduced in NADPH-supplemented rat-liver microsomes, as indicated by the rapid appearance of HQ and disappearance of BQ.
sentences.175: The absence of any EDTA effect on the ascorbate, ascorbate + hydroquione or ascorbate + benzoquinone- induced OH radical formation suggests that iron did not play an important role in the ascorbate effect.
sentences.176: Lipid peroxidation did not mediate CYP destruction by the quinones, since they did not induce it, but it could play a significant role in the NADPH-induced CYP destruction, as has been reported pre- viously (18,19).
sentences.177: Unlike hydroxyl radicals, increasing concentrations of the quinones proportionally decreased the NADPH- induced lipid peroxidation.
sentences.178: Since low con- centrations of the quinones decreased CYP destruction induced by NADPH (Figure 3), the quinones may have partly protected CYP against destruction by decreasing lipid peroxidation.
sentences.179: However, at quinone concen- trations above 0.5 mM, their direct destructive effects apparently prevailed, since they completely suppressed lipid peroxidation; yet they markedly destroyed CYP.
sentences.18: Benzene treat- ment induces its own metabolism by CYP whereby it is oxidized to phenol, hydro- quinone, and other metabolites by CYP2E1 in rat, mouse, and human (3)(4)(5)(6)(7)(8)(9)(10)(11).
sentences.180: The present results confirm previous indirect evidence (1) that BQ and SQ are responsible for the CYP destruction caused by HQ and BQ and show that neither OH radicals nor lipid peroxidation play a significant role in the quinone toxicity.
sentences.181: Ascorbate probably caused CYP destruction by inducing high levels of OH' radicals and lipid peroxidation, while iron seemed to play no role in its action.
sentences.182: The mutual miti- gating effect of the quinones, NADPH, and ascorbate on CYP destruction they caused while acting separately appeared to be mostly related to their chemical interactions.
sentences.183: Iron apparently played a key role in the NADPH-induced lipid peroxidation that EDTA completely inhibited.
sentences.184: The fact that HQ and BQ also inhibited lipid per- oxidation might be related to the observation that HQ and 1,2,4-benzenetriol chelate iron (35), which may explain their interactions in causing and reversing CYP destruction.
sentences.185: It also indicates that several mechanisms of toxicity may participate in these complex mixtures, while in specific conditions one of them predominates.

state.hypothesis: BK virus infection causes urothelial carcinoma in immunosuppressed individuals.

sentences.0: Renal transplant recipients are at increased risk of bladder carcinoma.
sentences.1: The aetiology is unknown but a polyoma virus (PV), BK virus (BKV), may play a role; urinary reactivation of this virus is common post-renal transplantation and PV large T-antigen (T-Ag) has transforming activity.
sentences.10: Infection with oncogenic viruses is one possible explanation, and BK virus (BKV) is a potential candidate virus.
sentences.11: BKV, a polyoma virus (PV), was first identified in 1971, in a renal transplant recipient with ureteric stenosis.
sentences.12: It infects 90% of the population during childhood and subsequently remains latent in the epithelium of the urinary tract.
sentences.13: Urinary reactivation of the virus is seen in approximately 30% of renal transplant recipients receiving modern immunosuppressive protocols.
sentences.14: Persistent high levels of urothelial reactivation are associated with an increased risk of infection of the renal tubules within the graft, resulting in PV nephropathy (PVN) that occurs in 3–5% of renal transplant recipients.
sentences.15: This is a relatively recent phenomenon that was first described in 1995.
sentences.16: The first patient with PVN in our unit in Oxford was diagnosed in 2000.
sentences.17: Current potent immunosuppressive regimens, the combination of tacrolimus and mycophenolate mofetil (MMF) in particular, have been implicated in the emergence of this complication.
sentences.18: The polyoma viruses, including BKV, have transforming activity, although a role in human neoplasia is yet to be demonstrated.
sentences.19: PV expresses a viral oncogene, the large T-antigen (T-Ag) that inactivates the pocket protein family, including pRb.
sentences.2: In this study, we investigate the potential role of BKV in post-transplant urothelial carcinoma by immunostaining tumour tissue for PV T-Ag.
sentences.20: It has recently been demonstrated that the BKV T-Ag activates the DNA methyltransferase 1 gene – DNMT1.
sentences.21: DNMT1 is associated with tumorigenesis through tumour suppressor gene hypermethylation.
sentences.22: In this study, we investigate the potential role of BKV in urothelial carcinoma in immunocompetent individuals and following renal transplantation by staining of tumour tissue with antibody against PV T-Ag.
sentences.23: Materials and methods
sentences.24: Patients
sentences.25: Search of the local renal transplant database (1990–2007) revealed 10 patients with post-transplant urothelial carcinoma of the bladder in our unit, eight of whom had archival paraffin blocks of tumour tissue available for study.
sentences.26: A control group of immunocompetent individuals with carcinoma of the bladder was identified.
sentences.27: These were 20 consecutive non-transplant patients diagnosed with high-grade invasive urothelial carcinoma in 2006.
sentences.28: Ethics approval was obtained for the study of bladder tumours and renal tissue from renal transplant recipients (ethics committee reference numbers O-02.062 and 04/Q1606/96).
sentences.29: Immunohistochemistry (IH)
sentences.3: There was no positivity for PV T-Ag in urothelial carcinomas from 20 non-transplant patients.
sentences.30: Immunohistochemistry for PV T-Ag was performed using a primary monoclonal anti-SV40 T-Ag (Calbiochem, San Diego, CA, USA).
sentences.31: This antibody stains all human polyoma viruses, including BKV.
sentences.32: Before incubation with the antibody, antigen retrieval was performed using a pressure cooker for 60–90 s at high pressure, with paraffin sections in 0.01 M citrate buffer at pH 6.
sentences.33: Primary antibody staining was done for 30 min at a dilution of 1/200.
sentences.34: The detection system used was Vector Elite ABC, Burlingame, CA, USA.
sentences.35: Results
sentences.36: The 20 non-transplant tumours were all negative for PV T-Ag on IH.
sentences.37: The patients with transplant-associated urothelial carcinoma are summarised in Table 1.
sentences.38: Of the eight patients with tissue available for review and staining, the mean age at diagnosis was 58 years and male/female ratio was 2 : 6.
sentences.39: Two patients (7 and 8) were transplanted since the first case of BKV nephropathy was diagnosed in Oxford in 2000.
sentences.4: Since 1990, 10 transplant recipients in our unit have developed urothelial carcinoma, and tumour tissue was available in eight recipients.
sentences.40: Both patients showed post-transplant reactivation of BKV, one diagnosed on renal biopsy and the other on urine cytology.
sentences.41: One of eight urothelial carcinomas in transplant recipients (patient 7) showed strong nuclear staining for PV T-Ag in virtually all tumour cells, with negative staining in adjacent non-neoplastic urothelium (Figure 1).
sentences.42: Typical intranuclear inclusions were not seen on H&E sections and there was no lymphocytic response to the PV-positive tumour cells, even following reduced immunosuppression for 6 weeks after diagnosis and before cystectomy.
sentences.43: Patient 7 is a 40-year-old woman, who received a renal transplant in 2001.
sentences.44: Her initial immunosuppression was ciclosporin, azathioprine and prednisolone.
sentences.45: However, she suffered three early rejections: a Banff 97 type IA rejection at day 7 post-transplantation, treated with 3 days of pulse methylprednisolone; a Banff 97 type III rejection at 13 days post-transplantation, treated with antithymocyte globulin and a Banff 97 type IB rejection, diagnosed at 27 days post-transplantation.
sentences.46: The latter was treated with a second 3-day course of pulse methylprednisolone, followed by switch of ciclosporin and azathioprine to tacrolimus and MMF.
sentences.47: No urine cytology to detect PV reactivation was performed, but PVN was diagnosed retrospectively using IH for PV T-Ag in a renal biopsy performed for graft dysfunction at 2 years post-transplantation (Figure 2).
sentences.48: This showed a minor non-specific infiltrate with no viral inclusions apparent on the H&E stain.
sentences.49: Her bladder tumour was diagnosed 4 years post-transplantation and was treated with radical cystectomy, bilateral native nephrectomy and hysterectomy.
sentences.5: Two patients were transplanted since the first case of PV nephropathy (PVN) was diagnosed in our unit in 2000 and both showed PV reactivation post-transplantation.
sentences.50: Her renal allograft shows good functioning 6 years post-transplantation (serum creatinine 137 μmol l−1).
sentences.51: Patient 8 is a 65-year-old woman, transplanted in 2004.
sentences.52: She developed BKV reactivation 5 months post-transplantation, diagnosed on urine cytology, but did not have biopsy-proven BKV nephropathy.
sentences.53: She developed graft dysfunction 2.5 years post-transplantation, biopsy showing chronic damage with active rejection.
sentences.54: Urine cytology at this time showed large numbers of atypical cells distributed singly, which were initially interpreted as decoy cells, indicative of BKV infection (Figure 3A).
sentences.55: However, in the third urine specimen (3 months after the first), aggregates of atypical cells were present, suggesting high-grade urothelial carcinoma (Figure 3B).
sentences.56: Urothelial carcinoma in situ was confirmed on biopsy (Figure 3C) and this was negative for PV T-Ag.
sentences.57: Discussion
sentences.58: There is conflicting evidence of a role for BKV in urothelial carcinoma in immunocompetent individuals.
sentences.59: reported a significant association between urine cytology suggestive of PV infection and subsequent diagnosis of bladder carcinoma.
sentences.6: In one of these patients, there was strong nuclear staining for PV T-Ag in tumour cells, with no staining of non-neoplastic urothelium.
sentences.60: However, this study did not confirm PV positivity with IH and the urinary findings may have been secondary to early urothelial carcinoma.
sentences.61: The distinction of BKV infection from urothelial malignancy can be very difficult on cytomorphology alone, as illustrated by a recent study and by case 8 in our series.
sentences.62: In a case–control study, found no association between prevalence or titres of anti-BKV antibodies and diagnosis of bladder cancer.
sentences.63: A recent tissue-based study detected BKV DNA by PCR in only 5.5% of urothelial carcinomas, all of which were negative on IH for BKV T-Ag. Similarly, we found no evidence of PV T-Ag in urothelial carcinoma from 20 immunocompetent patients.
sentences.64: There has been no previous systematic study of BKV in transplant-associated urothelial carcinoma.
sentences.65: reported a single patient who developed PVN following simultaneous pancreas–kidney transplant and who subsequently developed carcinoma of the bladder that was diffusely positive for PV T-Ag on IH, confirmed to be BKV by PCR.
sentences.66: Patient 7 in our series closely resembles this case.
sentences.67: PV T-Ag positivity in the tumour tissue of our patient implicates a polyoma virus in tumorigenesis but is not specific for BKV.
sentences.68: Although this is the most likely candidate virus, BKV-specific PCR was not performed and the presence of another polyoma virus could not be excluded.
sentences.69: The association of PV-positive urothelial carcinoma and PVN in these patients suggests that persistent or high levels of post-transplant urinary reactivation of BKV may have a pathogenic role in the development of urothelial carcinoma.
sentences.7: We conclude that PV infection is not associated with urothelial carcinoma in non-transplant patients, and is uncommon in transplant-associated tumours.
sentences.70: Alternatively, it is possible that tumour cells are more susceptible to BKV infection than normal urothelium, as infection occurs primarily in proliferating cells, and that positivity is a consequence rather than cause of neoplastic transformation.
sentences.71: Urine cytology screening for BKV reactivation post-transplantation is now routine in many units, including ours.
sentences.72: Long-term follow-up of these patients is required to demonstrate an association between viral reactivation and subsequent tumour development, and thus confirm the potential oncogenic role of BKV.
sentences.8: Its presence in all tumour cells in one patient transplanted in the PVN era might suggest a possible role in tumorigenesis in that case.
sentences.9: Renal transplant recipients carry a three- to four-fold increased risk of urothelial carcinoma when compared with the general population, the cause of which is unknown.

sentences.133: Discussion
sentences.134: In recent years several laboratories have been using ACFs as an end point in short-term tests for predicting colon car- cinogenesis in rodents (Tudek et al., 1989; Corpet et al.,  1990; Pretlow et al., 1990; Zhang et al., 1992).
sentences.135: ACFs are easily scored in the unsectioned colon of carcinogen-treated animals, and they develop as early as 2-4 weeks after car- cinogen administration.
sentences.136: Moreover, the ACF assay requires a relatively small number of animals and a short experimental time as compared with long-term carcinogenesis studies.
sentences.137: Therefore this assay has attained considerable popularity as a short-term test for the study of the modulating effects of chemicals and/or dietary factors on experimental colon car- cinogenesis.
sentences.138: Notwithstanding the merits of the ACF assay, the relation- ship between ACFs and carcinogenesis seems to be rather complicated.
sentences.139: It is certain that colon carcinogens induce ACFs dose dependently and that the number of ACFs is correlated with the potency of the carcinogen (Tudek et al., 1993).
sentences.14: However, since the first descrip- tion of ACFs in the literature (Bird, 1987), some researchers have wondered whether ACFs may truly be considered preneoplastic lesions and they have tried to identify dysplastic characteristics (such as nuclear alterations and abnormal luminal structure) or molecular abnormalities (such as activa- tion of some oncogenes) in ACFs (McLellan et al., 1991a,b;  Roncucci et al., 1991b; Stopera and Bird, 1992; Stopera et  al., 1992; Vivona et al., 1993).
sentences.140: However, some authors (Hardman et al., 1991) have not observed an association between the incidence of colon cancer and ACF number or size, and most others do not use the same parameters to describe the association of ACFs with carcinogenesis.
sentences.141: Some authors stress the importance of ACF multiplicity (AC/ACF) (Magnuson et al., 1993), while others favour the number of 'large' ACFs, but they calculate 'large' ACFs using different criteria (Corpet et al., 1990;  Pretlow et al., 1992; Zhang et al., 1992).
sentences.142: Given the current undetermined relationship between ACFs and carcinogenesis, the validity of the ACF assay has been questioned (Hardman et al., 1991; Magnuson et al.,   1993) and the possibility has been raised that ACFs are elementary lesions, only a few of which are truly preneoplastic.
sentences.143: Some authors have also studied genetic lesions which occur in colon adenomas and carcinomas in ACFs.
sentences.144: Accordingly, it has been demonstrated that a small subpopulation of ACFs have increased expression and activation of the ras oncogene (Stopera and Bird, 1992; Stopera et al., 1992; Vivona et al.,  1993).
sentences.145: Other studies have focused on ACF dysplasia, with the aim of identifying the actual dysplastic lesions within the ACF population (McLellan et al., 1991b; Roncucci et al.,  1991b).
sentences.146: The limitation of these studies is that only a small
sentences.147: In the present paper we try to identify and quantify a series of morphological alterations in ACFs observed in whole unsectioned colons with the same topographical approach used for the determination of ACFs with the methylene blue staining technique.
sentences.148: We performed two sets of experiments, one in which ACFs were induced by DMH and a second one involving AOM, a metabolite of DMH cur- rently used in colon carcinogenesis studies.
sentences.149: We observed some morphological alterations (nuclear and luminal alterations and goblet cell reduction) in a relatively large number of ACFs (about 300).
sentences.15: The results of these studies indicate that some ACFs are indeed dysplastic lesions.
sentences.150: Usually the evaluation of morphological alterations in a tissue is carried out on histological sections, in which various morphological aspects of dysplasia are determined (Morson  et al., 1992).
sentences.151: In the present study, we attempted to identify morphological alterations, similar to those characterising dysplasia, in unsectioned specimens; in fact, the differential staining of ACFs with methylene blue is in itself a sign of altered cellular and tissue structures.
sentences.152: The alterations that we observed in the ACFs are relatively modest, although they seem to be similar to the dysplastic alterations observed in histological specimens of adenomas or microadenomas.
sentences.153: In these lesions, the cytoarchitectural alterations and dysplastic characteristics are usually more evident and severe than those observed in ACFS, due partially to a larger size of adenomas or microadenomas.
sentences.154: In fact, if the same criteria used to graduate dysplasia in adenomas are applied to ACFs, the majority of ACFs would be graded as having mild or moderate morphological alterations.
sentences.155: We find that luminal alteration, goblet cell reduction and nuclear alterations of the cells surrounding the lumen of the crypt are correlated with increased multiplicity of ACFs.
sentences.156: These results suggest that the growth of at least some ACFs (as assessed by increased ACF multiplicity) is accompanied by acquisition of dysplastic features typical of precancerous lesions.
sentences.157: We demonstrate that it is possible to study mucin production by ACFs, determining sulpho-and sialomucins in whole unsectioned distal colons stained with the HID-AB tech- nique.
sentences.158: We can detect ACFs with the HID-AB technique as well as with methylene blue staining, as demonstrated by the highly significant correlation between the number of ACFs per colon and multiplicity using the two methods.
sentences.159: ACFs secreting only sulphomucins are progressively reduced in number as crypt multiplicity increases.
sentences.16: How- ever, only a limited number of ACFs have been evaluated in the previous studies, and it is not yet clear whether all the ACFs that are observed in the methylene blue-stained colon possess dysplastic features.
sentences.160: On the other hand, ACFs containing both sulpho-and sialomucins progressively increase as does crypt multiplicity.
sentences.161: A progression from sul- phomucin to sialomucin production has been described in colon microadenomas and dysplastic foci in histological sec- tions of the colon of DMH-treated rats, and it has been suggested that this mucin alteration occurs early in colon carcinogenesis (Filipe, 1975;Wargovich et al., 1983;Sand- forth et al., 1988).
sentences.162: Therefore, similarly to what is observed for the morphological alterations, these results suggest that most ACFs, when growing, tend to lose the characteristics of normal mucosa, gaining those of preneoplastic lesions.
sentences.163: We attempted to study the association between carcinogenesis and ACFs by examining the different parameters of ACFs in tumour-bearing and tumour-free rats.
sentences.164: Therefore, we evaluated the probability of bearing a tumour as a function of each of the different parameters of ACFs analysed using a logistic regression model.
sentences.165: The results of this effort demonstrate, in agreement with previous results (Hardman et  al., 1991; Magnuson et al., 1993), that there is no association between the total number of ACFs or their multiplicity and the presence of tumour in the animal.
sentences.166: We observed that tumour-free animals had the same number and multiplicity of ACFs as those bearing tumours.
sentences.167: On the other hand, we found that the tumour-free rats have significantly fewer 'large' ACFs (> 14 AC/ACF) than tumour-bearing rats and that the probability of bearing a tumour in relation to the presence of large ACFs is statistically significant (P= 0.04).
sentences.168: Our results show a borderline significant association (P = 0.057) between the presence of sialomucin-producing ACFs and the probability of bearing a tumour, sialomucins being more represented in the ACFs of tumour-bearing animals than in those of tumour-free rats.
sentences.169: On the basis of our results, we suggest that the best parameter for studying the association between carcinogenesis and ACF is the number of 'large' ACFs and the presence of sialomucin-producing ACFs.
sentences.17: Nor is it clear whether ACFs can be considered a reliable end point in experimental colon carcinogenesis (Hardman et al., 1991; Bird and Pretlow,  1992; Dolara and Caderni, 1992).
sentences.170: It is not yet clear if the ACFs that have an abnormal secretion of sialomucin and large dimensions are the same as those which accumulate genetic damage relevant for cancer developement.
sentences.171: Most previous genetic studies with this model were carried out on small populations of ACFs, and the association between size and expression of genetic damage was not studied.
sentences.172: It would be useful if protocols could be developed to screen the ACFs in whole colon with molecular biological methods.
sentences.173: In the meantime an improvement in the performance of the ACF assay might be possible, by classifying ACFs using these two simple morphological parameters (number of large ACFs and sialomucin production).
sentences.175: Financial support for this work came from grants from the Progetto finalizzato ACRO of CNR, Progetto finalizzato FATMA, EEC pro- gram AIR (Grant No. CT94/0933), Regione Toscana and MURST.
sentences.18: In fact, to use ACFs as predictor of cancer frequency in treated animals, different methods have been adopted to define the characteristics of ACFs to be correlated with carcinogenesis.
sentences.19: In some studies the total number of ACFs or ACF crypt multiplicity have been used; in some others the numbers of 'large' ACFs were considered (Corpet et al.,  1990; Pretlow et al., 1992; Zhang et al., 1992; Magnuson et  al., 1993).
sentences.2: Carcinogen-treated rats develop foci of aberrant crypts in the colon (ACFs) that have been interpreted as preneoplastic lesions.
sentences.20: Although in most studies large ACFs are con- sidered an indication of rapid growth, no consensus has thus far been reached on the most appropriate method of relating ACFs to carcinogenesis.
sentences.21: To characterise further the pathology of ACFs and its correlation with carcinogenesis, we decided to study ACFs in the unsectioned colon of rats at different times after 1,2dimethylhydrazine (DMH) or azoxymethane (AOM) admin- istration.
sentences.22: Accordingly, we determined in ACFs induced by these two carcinogens the number, multiplicity and some morphological alterations such as an abnormal luminal pat- tern, the reduction in goblet cells and the nuclear alteration in the cells surrounding the aberrant crypts.
sentences.23: We were also interested in studying mucin production in ACFs observed in unsectioned colons.
sentences.24: Previous investigations performed in his- tological sections have shown that apparently normal colonic mucosa from patients with colon cancer and dysplastic foci observed in the distal colon of carcinogen-treated rats (Filipe  and Branfoot, 1974; Filipe, 1975; Wargovich et al., 1983;  Sandforth et al., 1988) produce predominantly sialomucins instead of sulphomucins as the normal mucosa.
sentences.25: Materials and methods
sentences.26: Induction of ACFs by DMH and AOM
sentences.27: ACFs were induced with two different experimental pro- tocols.
sentences.28: In the first we used 8to 9-week-old female Sprague-Dawley rats (Morini, Italy).
sentences.29: Animals were fed a diet based on the AIN 76 diet (American Institute of Nutri- tion, 1977), modified to contain a relatively high amount of fat (23% corn oil), 23% sucrose and 23% starch as source of carbohydrates (Caderni et al., 1991).
sentences.3: To characterise ACFs further, we studied in the unsectioned colon of rats the number, multiplicity, some morphological characteristics and the type of mucin production in ACFs.
sentences.30: The rats were treated twice p.o., 4 days apart, either with saline or with DMH (Sigma Chimica, Milan, Italy) at a dose of 25 mg kg-' body weight (total dose 50 mg kg-').
sentences.31: Forty and 115 days after the first treatment with DMH the animals were sacrificed by decapitation under a light ether anaesthesia.
sentences.32: Each group was composed of 16 saline-treated and 16 DMH-treated rats.
sentences.33: In the second protocol we used male Sprague-Dawley rats (4-5 weeks old), fed a diet of the same composition as described above.
sentences.34: One week after the beginning of the experi- mental diet rats were treated s.c. with AOM (Sigma Chimica) at a weekly dose of 8 mg kg-' body weight for 8 weeks (total dose 64 mg kg-').
sentences.35: We had 60 AOM-treated and 15 saline- treated rats.
sentences.36: Between 158 and 162 days after the first dose of AOM the animals were sacrificed by decapitation and ACFs and intestinal tumours were studied.
sentences.37: Cancer histological types were evaluated on the basis of histotype, grading and pattern of growth according to Morson et al. (1992).
sentences.38: In all the experiments rats were maintained at a constant environmental temperature of 22°C, with a 12 h light-dark cycle, according to internationally accepted ethical guidelines for the treatment of experimental animals (European Community, 1986).
sentences.39: Determination of the number, multiplicity and morphological alterations of ACFs
sentences.4: In ACFs observed 115 days after the administration of 50 mg kg-' 1,2-dimethylhydrazine (DMH), crypt multip- licity [number of aberrant crypts (AC) per focus] was positively correlated (P<0.0001) with the reduction of goblet cells, and with luminal and nuclear alterations in the cells surrounding the lumen of the ACs.
sentences.40: To visualise the ACFs induced by DMH or AOM treatments, we stained the unsectioned colon with methylene blue according to Bird (1987).
sentences.41: For each rat we determined the number of ACFs in the entire colon and their multiplicity by counting the number of ACs forming each focus (AC/ ACF).
sentences.42: Moreover, in the colon of the rats sacrificed 115 days after DMH, 20 ACFs were randomly chosen from each rat and evaluated for the following architectural and cytological characteristics: pattern of luminal outline of the ACs (referred to as 'luminal alteration'), nuclear alteration with appearance of pseudostratification of the nuclei in the cells surrounding the lumen (referred to as 'nuclear alteration') and reduction in the number of goblet cells.
sentences.43: This evaluation was carried out on unsectioned colons stained with methylene blue (magnification 40 -100 x).
sentences.44: To evaluate the luminal alteration of the ACs, each AC was graded as mildly altered if the luminal outline was enlarged and round, moderately altered if elliptical or severely altered if slit-like, irregular and cribriform.
sentences.45: In the cytological analysis of the nuclear alteration each AC was graded as mildly, moderately or severely altered depending on whether the nuclei, which in normal cells constitute a single layer close to the bases of the cells, seemed to occupy less than 35%, 35-50% or more than 50% of the cell space (epithelium) respectively.
sentences.46: In the analysis of the reduction of goblet cells each AC was graded as mildly, moderately or severely altered depending on whether the reduction in the number of goblet cells was, respectively, less than 10%, 10-50% or more than 50% compared with those surrounding the normal crypts.
sentences.47: To each grade of morphological alteration we arbitrarily attributed the value of 1, 2 or 3 (for mild, moderate and severe altera- tion respectively).
sentences.48: Finally, the overall grade of ACF altera- tion was calculated by summing these values for each AC forming the focus and then dividing this value by the number of ACs in that focus.
sentences.49: Determination of mucus production in the ACFs
sentences.5: We studied mucin production in the unsectioned colon, demonstrating that ACFs producing sulphomucins (like the normal distal rat colon) were progressively reduced when ACF multiplicity increased, whereas ACFs containing sialomucins (correlated with an increased risk of colon cancer) or both sulphomucins and sialomucins increased with crypt multiplicity.
sentences.50: After the determination of the number of multiplicity of the ACFs using the methylene blue staining method, the colons were kept in buffered formalin and later processed with the high-iron diamine Alcian blue (HID-AB) procedure for the analysis of mucus production (Filipe, 1975).
sentences.51: Briefly, the entire colon was rinsed for 5 min in distilled water and then transferred into a Petri dish containing a freshly prepared solution, referred to as diamine solution, obtained by dissolv- ing simultaneously 120 mg of N-N'-dimethyl-m-phenylene diamine and 20mg of N-N'-dimethyl-p-phenylene diamine (Sigma Chimica) in 50 ml of distilled water and then adding 1.4 ml of 60% ferric chloride.
sentences.52: The Petri dish was covered with aluminium foil for protection against the light and the colon was stained by the diamine solution for 18 h at room temperature.
sentences.53: The colon was then rinsed three times in dis- tilled water and stained for 30 min with a solution of 1%
sentences.54: Alcian blue (Sigma Chimica) in 3% acetic acid.
sentences.55: The colon was then rinsed three times with 80% ethanol followed by distilled water and observed under the microscope with the mucosal side up at a magnification of 40 x.
sentences.56: As a result of this procedure the cells surrounding the opening of the crypts in the distal part of the colon were stained dark brown, indicating a predominance of sulphomucin secretion.
sentences.57: Moving from the distal to the proximal part of the colon the cells surrounding the opening of the crypts became increasingly blue, indicating a predominance of sialomucin secretion.
sentences.58: This shift from sulphomucin to sialomucin production along the length of the rat colon, going towards the proximal part, has been previously described in histological sections (Filipe, 1975).
sentences.59: We examined only the distal part of the rat colons since the distal colon shows a pattern of mucus production similar to that of the normal human colorectal mucosa in which sulphomucin secretion predominates and since precancerous alterations in the human and distal rat colon are accom- panied by a shift from sulphomucin to sialomucin secretion (Filipe and Branfoot, 1974; Filipe, 1975).
sentences.6: We also studied ACFs in the colon and the occurrence of intestinal tumours in rats treated with azoxymethane (AOM; 64 mg kg-').
sentences.60: The examination of DMH-treated rats showed that after the HID-AB procedure the ACFs were stained either dark brown, like the normal surrounding crypts (in which sulphomucin production predominates), or blue (in which sialomucin production predominates; Figure la), or both brown and blue together (in which sulphomucins and sialomucins were present together; Figure lb).
sentences.61: The dark-brown ACFs were easily dis- tinguished from the normal crypts, being larger and with a thicker epithelial lining; the blue and blue-brown ACFs, besides the morphological characteristics pertaining to these lesions (Bird, 1987), were easily identified against the back- ground of normal brown crypts (Figure la andb).
sentences.62: The number of ACFs and their multiplicity (AC/ACF) scored with the methylene blue and with HID-AB technique were significantly correlated (r= 0.88 and 0.96 for the number of ACFs and AC/ACF respectively).
sentences.63: Statistical analysis of the data Differences between means were evaluated using Student's t-test for unpaired samples; the correlations between the alterations of the morphological parameters and the multiplicity of ACFs were analysed by a linear regression model using Statgraphics Statistical Package (Statistical Graphic Corporation, Rockville, MD, USA).
sentences.64: To establish whether an ACF parameter would relate to tumour incidence in carcinogen-treated rats, we evaluated the probability of bearing a tumour as a function of each of the different parameters of ACFs analysed, by means of a logistic regression model in which the binary response was bearing or not bearing a tumour.
sentences.65: For each parameter, the regression coefficient is an estimate of this association.
sentences.66: The odds ratio (OR) of each parameter is calculated as eregresson coeffcient = OR; the corresponding 95% confidejce limits (CLs) are obtained from the model fitting.
sentences.67: The association is considered statis- tically significant when the 95% CLs do not include the value of 1 (Rothman, 1986).
sentences.68: The association between the distribution of mucin production and bearing or not bearing a tumour was evaluated according to the generalised estimating equation (GEE) (Liang and Zeger, 1986), which is based on a logistic regres- sion model.
sentences.69: From this analysis we calculated odds ratios (OR) and the corresponding 95% CLs as described above.
sentences.7: A significant association was found (P = 0.04) between tumours and the presence of 'large' ACFs (AC/ACF> 14 crypts) and a borderline significant association (P = 0.057) between the presence of tumours and sialomucin-producing ACFs.
sentences.70: The application of GEE is appropriate when there is a correlation among observations.
sentences.71: In fact, within the same rat, three measurements were determined: the number of sulphomucin-producing ACFs, the number of ACFs produc- ing sulphoand sialomucins and the number of ACFs pro- ducing sialomucins.
sentences.72: These measurements are correlated with each other (r = 0.45), in the same rat (cluster).
sentences.73: Therefore, the dependence among observations from the same cluster (rat) must be accounted for in assessing the relationship between the different risk factors and tumour outcome.
sentences.74: Results
sentences.75: Characterisation of ACFs 40 and 115 days after DMH adninistration
sentences.76: We studied ACFs in the colons of rats treated twice, 4 days apart, with 25 mg kg-' DMH or saline and sacrificed 40 and 115 days after DMH administration.
sentences.77: The colon was first stained with methylene blue as described and the number of multiplicity of ACFs were determined.
sentences.78: The results indicated that the number of ACFs was similar in the rats sacrificed 40 or 115 days after DMH administration (82.5 ± 13.8 and 85.2 + 10.2, means ± s.e.).
sentences.79: As expected, the results also indicated that the multiplicity of ACFs (number of ACs/ ACF) was lower in rats sacrificed 40 days after DMH (1.78±0.05) than in rats sacrificed 115 days after (2.92± 0.17, means ± s.e., P < 0.001).
sentences.8: We found no association between the number of ACFs, ACF multiplicity and the presence of tumours.
sentences.80: No ACFs were found in the colon of saline-treated rats.
sentences.81: We then evaluated 20 ACFs randomly chosen in each rat sacrificed 115 days after DMH (total number of ACFs analysed = 313 -312) for the following morphological char- acteristics: nuclear alteration in the cells surrounding the lumen of the ACs, luminal alteration and reduction in the number of goblet cells as described in Materials and methods.
sentences.82: This evaluation was carried out by observing these parameters in the unsectioned colon, since with this topo- graphical approach it was possible to study more lesions than in histological sections.
sentences.83: Each AC or ACF was graded as having mild, moderate or severe alterations as described in the Materials and methods section.
sentences.84: The results indicated (Table I) that most ACs had mild or moderate alterations and only a few showed severe nuclear alteration and goblet cell reduction.
sentences.85: We also determined the grades of morphological alterations in ACFs as a function of their multiplicity (AC/ACF).
sentences.86: The results indicated (Figure 2a-c) that crypt multiplicity was positively correlated with the severity of all the morphological altera- tions analysed (luminal alteration, goblet cell reduction and nuclear alteration in the cells surrounding the lumen of the crypt).
sentences.87: We also studied the type of mucus produced by the ACFs.
sentences.88: The distal colon of each rat treated with DMH and sacrificed 40 and 115 days later was therefore stained with the HID-AB technique and the number and multipliciiy of the ACFs and type of mucus secreted were recorded.
sentences.89: The results relative to the rats sacrificed 115 days after DMH (Table II) indicated that some of the ACFs still retained the sulphomucin secre- tion typical of the normal mucosa but that most ACFs secreted both sulphoand sialomucins.
sentences.9: Data from experimental animals and humans indicate that colon carcinogenesis is a multistep process in which subsequent preneoplastic lesions accumulate in some mucosa cells, leading finally to neoplastic transformation (Day, 1984; Mor- son et al., 1992).
sentences.90: A smaller fraction of ACFs secreted only sialomucins.
sentences.91: Similarly, 40 days after the carcinogen treatment, most ACFs secreted sulphoand sialomucins (data not shown).
sentences.92: We calculated the correlation between the type of mucin produced by the ACFs and ACF multiplicity.
sentences.93: The results relative to ACFs observed 115 days after DMH indicated (Figure 2d) that, when ACF multiplicity increased, the percentage of ACFs producing sulphomucins decreased rapidly, while the percentage of ACFs containing both sulphomucins and sialomucins progressively increased.
sentences.94: A few ACFs composed entirely of sialomucins were also observed in ACFs formed by few crypts, and their number slowly increased with the increase in ACF muliplicity.
sentences.95: The ACFs observed in rats sacrificed 40 days after DMH showed a similar correlation between mucin production and crypt multiplicity (data not shown).
sentences.96: Characterisation of ACFs determined 160 days after AOM administration in rats with and without tumours Rats were treated with 8 mg kg-' AOM weekly for 8 weeks and sacrificed 158-162 days after the first injection with AOM.
sentences.97: At this time (about 160 days after AOM) we studied intestinal tumours and ACFs in the colon.
sentences.98: The results of histopathological examination of the whole intestine (Table III) indicated that the majority of tumours (both adenocar- cinomas and adenomas) were induced in the colon, and only a few were found in the small intestine.
sentences.99: The control rats treated with saline did not develop tumours.

sentences.92: The present study evaluated complaints of impaired memory by female solvent-exposed workers following Delay Before Recall (s) acute exposure to toluene and aliphatic hydrocarbons.

state.hypothesis: Merkel cell polyomavirus causes Merkel cell carcinoma.

sentences.0: Merkel cell carcinoma (MCC) is a relatively uncommon but highly lethal form of skin cancer.
sentences.1: A majority of MCC tumors carry DNA sequences derived from a newly identified virus called Merkel cell polyomavirus (MCV or MCPyV), a candidate etiologic agent underlying the development of MCC.
sentences.10: This suggests that a VLP-based vaccine could be effective for preventing the initial establishment of MCV infection.
sentences.100: Optimized polyomavirus VLP EIA methods use VP1 doses ranging from 6 to 200 ng per well, suggesting that polyomavirus VLP EIA could not be adapted to the <240 pg/well doses required to comply with the percentage law.
sentences.101: The data indicate that the neutralization assay offers a more accurate and sensitive measurement of serological responsiveness to MCV than the EIA.
sentences.102: The fact that the neutralization assay is insensitive to virion dose would also be expected to make it more reproducible than the EIA.
sentences.103: To further explore the relative accuracy of the neutralization assay, we tested serial dilutions of sera from a selected set of 10 blood donors whose EIA reactivity was robust enough to allow calculation of an EC50 value.
sentences.104: The blood donors were compared to 12 MCC patients whose tumors were found to harbor MCV DNA sequences.
sentences.105: As seen in Figure 3, the neutralization assay allowed improved discrimination between the two groups' seroresponsiveness to MCV.
sentences.106: While the EIA suggested a 4-fold difference between the geometric mean titers (GMT) of the blood donor and MCC patient groups (GMT of 876 and 3,390, respectively), the neutralization assay revealed a >10-fold difference (GMT of 21,500 and 222,000, respectively) between the two groups, with correspondingly stronger p values (Figure 3).
sentences.107: Furthermore, EIA EC50 values for individual subjects were an average of 50-fold lower than their neutralizing EC50 values (Figure S2), confirming the greater accuracy of the neutralization assay.
sentences.108: MCC patients display unusually strong MCV-neutralizing responses
sentences.109: It was striking that subjects with MCC displayed significantly higher neutralizing titers than a selected group of strongly seropositive blood donors (Figure 3).
sentences.11: Author Summary
sentences.110: To better characterize this apparent difference; we tested a set of 48 sera from older adults (age range 47–75 years) without diagnosed MCC.
sentences.111: The control subject sera were compared to a total of 21 MCV-positive MCC patients (age range 14–95 years).
sentences.112: As seen in Figure 3, MCV+ MCC patients invariably displayed high titer MCV-neutralizing responses, with a GMT of 160,000.
sentences.113: Control subjects, in contrast, showed a broad, continuous distribution of neutralizing titers, with a significantly lower GMT of 2700 (p<0.0001).
sentences.114: Only 7/48 (15%) of control subjects displayed titers within or above the interquartile range of the MCV+ MCC patient population.
sentences.115: The prevalence of MCV-neutralizing activity in the control subject population was high, with 88% (42/48) of the subjects displaying EC50 values falling within the tested range of serum dilutions.
sentences.116: It is not clear whether sera with titers below 100 are weakly MCV seropositive or rather contain non-specific neutralizing activity, as was observed for the pre-immune rabbit serum (Figure 1).
sentences.117: The neutralization assay results confirm recent findings showing that MCV-specific seroprevalence is common among older adults and suggests that the 67% EIA-based seroprevalence observed in this same group of subjects may have been a slight underestimate.
sentences.118: The presence of high MCV-specific titers in all the MCV-positive MCC patients could, in theory, reflect an immunocompromised state in which latent polyomavirus infections are allowed to resurface, triggering strong virus-specific antibody responses.
sentences.119: To test this hypothesis we evaluated sera from the same set of control subjects and MCC patients for the presence of anti-BKV antibodies using a BKV-based reporter vector.
sentences.12: For more than 50 years it has been known that some polyomavirus types can induce cancer in experimental animals.
sentences.120: There was no apparent correlation between BKV and MCV titers in individual subjects (data not shown), suggesting a lack of general reactivation of polyomaviruses as well as a lack of cross-reactivity between the two virus types in the neutralization assays.
sentences.121: The BKV GMT was 5,100 for control subjects and 2,300 for MCV-positive MCC patients (Figure 3).
sentences.122: This slight difference in titer was not statistically significant.
sentences.123: Sera from a set of six MCC patients whose tumors did not contain detectable amounts of MCV DNA were also tested in the neutralization assay.
sentences.124: 4/6 of the MCV− MCC patients displayed very low titers in the neutralization assay (Figure S3).
sentences.125: The incidence of MCV seroresponsiveness has been shown to increase with subject age, reaching an apparent maximum prevalence in late adulthood.
sentences.126: Age-specific trends in the MCV-neutralizing titers of the control subjects shown in Figure 4 were not evident, perhaps in part because the distribution of ages is clustered about the mean (56±5.7 years, Figure S3).
sentences.127: Interestingly, adult MCV+ MCC patients displayed a marginally significant inverse correlation between subject age and MCV-neutralizing titer (p = 0.0497, Spearman r = −0.4443, Figure S3).
sentences.128: The trend is reminiscent of the gradual age-related decline in BKV-specific antibody responses observed in cross-sectional studies of adults.
sentences.129: The data indicate that the higher MCV-specific titers of the MCC patients are unlikely to be attributable simply to their more advanced average age relative to the control subjects.
sentences.13: However, associations between the various polyomaviruses known to chronically infect most humans and the development of cancer have been difficult to uncover.

sentences.14: Last year, DNA from a new human polyomavirus, called Merkel cell polyomavirus (MCV), was found embedded in an uncommon form of skin cancer called Merkel cell carcinoma.

sentences.148: Development of a candidate MCV vaccine
sentences.149: To investigate the functional immunogenicity of MCV VLPs, serum from a rabbit inoculated with purified MCV VP1/VP2 VLPs was tested using the reporter vector neutralization assay.
sentences.15: Emerging evidence indicates that most adults display detectable immune responses to MCV, suggesting that most individuals eventually become infected with the virus.
